author: KiraWillis
quote: Disappointing and overly safe. Despite all the promises of complete freedom, there are no robberies outside the main storyline. The game pushes way too much focus onto Lucia, the in-game websites are gone, and for some reason, we got a clunky Instagram clone straight out of 2016. Not what I expected from GTA.

author: KiraWillis
